Work_Experience.description: A personal productivity tool built to track job applications. The Flask web app features a real-time dashboard (Jinja2) displaying application stats and pipeline status. Work_Experience.title: SmartSensorHub
responsibilities: Deployed an IoT sensor network on Raspberry Pi, containerized with Docker Compose
Built a secured Flask REST API (token auth) for automated incident reporting
Developed Python scripts for real-time anomaly detection and automated alerts
Work_Experience.description: End-of-year project at IUT Annecy: a smart sensor management platform built around a Raspberry Pi IoT network. The full stack is containerized with Docker Compose, integrating InfluxDB (token-restricted secure storage), Grafana dashboards, Home Assistant, and Z-Wave sensor modules. Python scripts handle real-time anomaly detection with automated alerting. A Flask REST API (token authentication) manages automatic incident reporting, backed by complete technical documentation.
